description: Shared notes presentation golden. Synthetic minimal quality cases; no financial source claim. Expected memberships/order/totals are explicitly authored. Messages are the data notes version 2 reason words (data_notes.REASONS and provenance.ts REASONS, equal), and marked notes take the first letters. record_only_reasons and summaries pin the marking rule's list and the fine print's summary words on both sides. Canonical keys use compact ASCII JSON and UTF-16 code-unit reason ordering.
